title: In-Context Scheming at Different Context Window Positions

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Informative for understanding how models process competing instructions, with implications for context management. However, the safety impact is secondary: position sensitivity is more of an architectural finding than a safety-critical one. The connection to deployment safety is through indirect context management strategies.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing long-context scenarios with controlled goal-injection positions. Long-context prompts are expensive (token costs) and require careful padding/filler design. The experimental design needs to control for multiple confounds (salience vs. position, context length effects).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single variable (position) but long-context experiments require substantial token budgets and careful design. Testing multiple positions across multiple scenarios adds up. Achievable in 30 hours if limited to one model and 3-4 position conditions.
